title: Blogger System & Platform Inclusions Master Catalog
description: Canonical registry of platform-level subroutines and system includables resolved by Google Blogger's backend rendering engine.

super_prefix_rule.description: Prefixing an inclusion identifier with super. (e.g. <b:include name='super.main'/>) instructs the Blogger engine to execute the default platform or theme implementation of that subroutine, bypassing template-level overrides.

all-head-content.name: all-head-content
all-head-content.description: Injects critical HTML document head elements, including OpenSearch link headers, feed discovery links, canonical link tags, generator meta tags, and platform core scripts.

google-analytics.name: google-analytics
google-analytics.description: Injects Google Analytics tracking code configured in the blog administration settings.

urlParamsAsFormInput.name: urlParamsAsFormInput
urlParamsAsFormInput.description: Preserves current URL query parameters as hidden form input fields when submitting search or filter forms.

quickedit.name: quickedit
quickedit.description: Renders the administrative wrench icon allowing authenticated blog owners to configure the current widget directly from the published page.

googlePlusBootstrap.name: googlePlusBootstrap
googlePlusBootstrap.description: Legacy Google+ identity and sharing SDK bootstrap script.
googlePlusBootstrap.deprecation_note: Google+ integration has been sunset by Google.

openGraphMetaData.name: openGraphMetaData
openGraphMetaData.description: Generates Open Graph protocol metadata tags (og:title, og:url, og:image, og:description) for enhanced social sharing.

reportAbuse.name: reportAbuse
reportAbuse.description: Renders the Blogger platform abuse reporting link conforming to Google Terms of Service requirements.

responsiveImageStyle.name: responsiveImageStyle
responsiveImageStyle.description: Emits dynamic inline CSS styling for responsive aspect ratios and container dimensions.

extendableItems.name: extendableItems

postSnippet.name: postSnippet
